=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text small "isqrt of 0..65:"
text pre "isqrt(7^"
text eqs ") = "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note the task's quadratic residue method: q is the least power of 4 above x, then one result bit per step
note bound: inputs here are below 2^60, so q stays at most 2^60 (30 doublings of the exponent) and never wraps;
note 7^n is shown for odd n up to 21, the largest odd power of 7 below 2^64 (the task goes on to 7^73 with bignums)
fn isqrt x ulong to ulong
q = ulong 1
while le q x bound 31
q = shl q 2
end
z = x
r = ulong 0
while gt q 1 bound 31
q = shr q 2
s = add r q
r = shr r 1
if ge z s
z = sub z s
r = add r q
end
end
ret r
end
fn main to int
emit small
for x ulong 66
emit sp
emitu isqrt x
end
emit nl
p = ulong 7
n = ulong 1
while le n 21 bound 11
emit pre
emitu n
emit eqs
emitu isqrt p
emit nl
p = mul p 49
n = add n 2
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
